name: Jyoti Nanda

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Jyoti Nanda is an Odia fiction writer, poet, essayist and translator. His books include the story collection Pingala Panjuri and the novel Pakshijanma. In a 2019 interview with Saroj Bal, he describes a growing understanding of fiction as social work, alongside his continuing interest in experiments with narrative form.

In “ବିପଜ୍ଜନକ ପ୍ରେମ କବିତା,” the lives of two labourers interrupt the polished language of poetry and the city’s confidence in progress. Road trenches, buried cables, loss and a proposed magic act converge in a question about what people are willing to see. Its love is inseparable from the insecurity and grief of working lives.
